events.title: Playtesting is now Open!
events.summary: We're excited to announce that playtesting for Goodnight, B has officially started! For those interested, you can join using the “Join Playtest” button on our Steam page, and you will automatically be admitted into the playtest.If you have any feedback or comments, feel free to join our Discord server or fill out our feedback form. We're so excited to see what you guys think of Goodnight, B!
